Freedom SW Xanbus Automatic Generator Start (809-0916, for first-generation 815-3000)

gotchas: A complete AGS Modbus map exists (503-0247-01-01 Rev A.4: generator mode 0x004D 0=Off 1=On 2=Automatic, quiet-time windows, preheat/crank/cooldown timers, run-hours at 0x006A scale 0.01666 hours, starting-battery voltage at 0x0078) — but its Table 1 'Applicable Products' lists exactly one product: 865-1060, Conext AGS.

This is the classic trap: same bus, same accessory role, same ComBox, plausible shared map — and zero evidence. Assigning 809-0915 to 503-0247 would cost a bench day if the maps forked. Left unknown on purpose.

What would settle it: an AGS owner's guide or ComBox device list naming 809-0915/809-0916 against the 503-0247 map, or two independent implementations reading those addresses from a Xantrex-branded AGS. Neither found.

Same situation for the Xanbus System Control Panel: map 503-0251 lists only 865-1050 (Conext SCP) and 865-1050-01 (XW SCP); the Xantrex parts are 809-0910 and 809-0921. Not filed as its own dialect because an SCP is a display panel, not a data source worth a driver.

Likewise the ComBox aggregate map 503-0253 lists 865-1058 / 865-1059 (Conext ComBox and Modbus Converter) — NOT the Xantrex Freedom SW ComBox 809-0918. So the system-level summary registers (PV Harvest Power, DC Charging Power, Grid/Load aggregate) are not confirmed available on the Xantrex ComBox.
